highlights.title: Cloud Bakes
highlights.description: Choose Cloud as Bake Location to simulate on PolyWorks GPUs. Review & Send shows the GPU, the credit rate and the cost ceiling before anything is sent.

highlights.title: Live Cloud status
highlights.description: The Bake window follows the job with server data: upload, queue, frames, GPU, server runtime and the settled cost.

highlights.title: Fair billing
highlights.description: The final cost follows the measured server runtime, start-up included, and never exceeds the confirmed ceiling.
